title: Listening
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s lesson
Joshua is now an OLD MAN
and his time is nearly up on earth

What did we learn from Joshua
TO BE BRAVE AND STRONG!

Joshua listened to the Lord, 
Joshua did whatever the Lord told him to do
Joshua
TRUSTED and OBEYED

Talk to Jesus
Dear Jesus
Thank you for making me brave
I love you so much
Please help me to listen to You
and to listen to my mom and dad
Amen
